children: ICICI Bank Limited Sponsored ADR (NSE:ICICIBANK) posted stronger Q2 standalone profit with rising NII, loan and deposit growth, improved asset quality and lower provisions while CET‑1/CAR stay comfortably above norms; analysts and Mirae Asset see further upside and credit-led growth despite slight NIM pressure.
ICICI Bank ADR Q2 Profit Rise
: ICICI Bank ADR (ICICIBANK) Q2: standalone profit rose, net interest income increased, loan book and deposits expanded, net interest margin narrowed, gross NPA improved, provisions fell.
CET‑1 16.01%, CAR 16.68%; 2% ICICI Life Stake Acquisition
: ICICIBANK: CET‑1 ratio 16.01%, total CAR 16.68%, both above regulatory minimums; acquired additional 2% stake in ICICI Life for Rs 1,470 crore.
: Analysts' consensus price target for ICICI Bank Limited Sponsored ADR (ICICIBANK) is $36.50, which is 29.1% higher than the ADR's most recent closing price of $28.27.
: Mirae Asset forecasts ICICIBANK Q2FY27: PAT +16% YoY, NII +11.2% YoY, loans +19% YoY, slight QoQ NIM drop (2–13 bps), stable asset quality, private banks may lead credit growth
Parag Parikh Keeps ICICI ADR Holdings
: Parag Parikh Flexi Cap Fund kept its ICICI Bank ADR (ICICIBANK) holding unchanged in September 2026; fund reduced cash and boosted other existing positions.
: ICICI Bank ADR (ICICIBANK) had 3.46 million inoperative Jan Dhan accounts as of Sep 23, 2026, up from 3.30 million a year earlier; 62% of its Jan Dhan accounts were inactive.
